caller said: Mepa wo kyɛw, sika ahe na aka wɔ me akawnt no mu?
Temi said: Sika a aka wɔ w'akawnt no mu yɛ sidi mpem abien.

caller said: Fa sidi aduonum kɔma Mum, na tɔ airtime sidi du ma me.
Temi said: Sidi aduonum kɔma Mum na sidi du airtime ma wo ara, yɛ?
Maka sidi aduonum ama Mum, na matɔ sidi du airtime ama wo.

caller said: Boa me na menkyerɛw nkra tiawa nkɔma me wɔfa sɛ mɛba fie Kwasiada.
Temi said: Wɔfa mekyia wo paa, mɛba fie Kwasiada. Ka kyerɛ me sɛ wopɛ sɛ mesesa biribi.

caller said: Mesrɛ wo, fa sidi aduonum kɔma Mum.
Temi said: Sidi aduonum a wopɛ sɛ memfa mma Mum no, memmfa nkɔ anaa
Mafa sidi aduonum ama Mum. Waka a aka yɛ sidi apem ahankron aduonum.
